Win a trip to the cinema

We've teamed up with Scott Cinemas to offer you a FREE cinema pass! 🍿

Listen every Friday afternoon for your chance to bag a pair of tickets to watch a title of your choice in either Sidmouth, Newton Abbot, Exmouth or Barnstaple.

We'll play a famous movie clip if you can guess what film it's from; the tickets are yours!

We'll also throw two medium combos, including popcorn with a fountain drink or Tango Ice Blast, to enjoy whilst you watch some of the best new releases.

 

How do I get involved?

💬 Message your answer on WhatsApp 0330 3800 390 
✉️ Send your name and number to studio@radioexe.co.uk

 

COMPETITION RULES: 

*Open to residents of Devon, Cornwall, Somerset, and Dorset aged 18+
*Once all the entries are in, one winner will be chosen at random
*The prize is not transferable, and no cash alternative is available
*Winners must redeem their tickets within three months of winning
*Entries are limited to one per person, per week
*Tickets don't include special events or premieres
